CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Destroy trees without planting

2. Which response best shows understanding of Work: God Worked? (1 mark)
   A. Say Work: God Worked has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Work: God Worked to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Work: God Worked.
   D. Apply the teaching of Work: God Worked with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Judge Deborah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Judge Deborah.
   B. Say Judge Deborah has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Judge Deborah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Judge Deborah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Kings David and Solomon? (1 mark)
   A. Say Kings David and Solomon has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Kings David and Solomon with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Kings David and Solomon to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Kings David and Solomon.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem.
   B. Use Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

7. Which response best shows understanding of Healing the 10 Lepers? (1 mark)
   A. Say Healing the 10 Lepers has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Healing the 10 Lepers to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Healing the 10 Lepers.
   D. Apply the teaching of Healing the 10 Lepers with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes.
   C. Say Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Nicodemus Encounter with Jesus Christ 8 3.5 Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 T? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Nicodemus Encounter with Jesus Christ 8 3.5 Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 T.
   B. Apply the teaching of Nicodemus Encounter with Jesus Christ 8 3.5 Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 T with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Nicodemus Encounter with Jesus Christ 8 3.5 Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 T to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Nicodemus Encounter with Jesus Christ 8 3.5 Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 T has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 The Church 4.1 The Early Church 8 4.2 The Gif? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 The Church 4.1 The Early Church 8 4.2 The Gif with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 The Church 4.1 The Early Church 8 4.2 The Gif has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 The Church 4.1 The Early Church 8 4.2 The Gif to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 The Church 4.1 The Early Church 8 4.2 The Gif.

11. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

12. Which response best shows understanding of Parable on prayer Midnight? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Parable on prayer Midnight with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Parable on prayer Midnight has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Parable on prayer Midnight to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Parable on prayer Midnight.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Work: God Worked and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Christian Moral Values: Purity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Judge Deborah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Kings David and Solomon and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

2. D — Apply the teaching of Work: God Worked with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. D — Apply the teaching of Healing the 10 Lepers with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. A — Apply the teaching of Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. B — Apply the teaching of Nicodemus Encounter with Jesus Christ 8 3.5 Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 T with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. A — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

12. A — Apply the teaching of Parable on prayer Midnight with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Judge Deborah; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
